statement:
Consider the sequence \((a_n)\) satisfying \(a_1 = \tfrac{1}{2}\), \(a_{n+1} = \sqrt[3]{3a_{n+1} - a_n}\) and \(0 \leq a_n \leq 1\) for all \(n \geq 1\).
a) Prove that the sequence \((a_n)\) is determined uniquely and has a finite limit.
b) Let \(b_n = (1 + 2a_1)(1 + 2^2 a_2)\cdots(1 + 2^n a_n)\) for all \(n \geq 1\). Prove that the sequence \((b_n)\) has a finite limit.

Given integers \(a, b, c, \alpha, \beta\) and the sequence \((u_n)\) defined by \(u_1 = \alpha\), \(u_2 = \beta\), \(u_{n+2} = au_{n+1} + bu_n + c\) for all \(n \geq 1\).
a) Prove that if \(a = 3\), \(b = -2\), \(c = -1\) then there are infinitely many pairs \((\alpha, \beta)\) of integers so that \(u_{2023} = 2^{2022}\).
b) Prove that there exists a positive integer \(n_0\) such that only one of the following is true:
 i) There are infinitely many positive integers \(m\) such that \(u_{n_0} u_{n_0+1} \cdots u_{n_0+m}\) is divisible by \(7^{2023}\) or \(17^{2023}\).
 ii) There are infinitely many positive integers \(k\) such that \(u_{n_0} u_{n_0+1} \cdots u_{n_0+k} - 1\) is divisible by \(2023\).

Find the maximum value of the positive real number \(k\) such that
\[\frac{1}{kab+c^2}+\frac{1}{kbc+a^2}+\frac{1}{kca+b^2} \geq \frac{k+3}{a^2+b^2+c^2}\]
holds for all positive reals \(a, b, c\) with \(a^2 + b^2 + c^2 = 2(ab + bc + ca)\).

Given triangle \(ABC\), let \(D\) be the midpoint of the major arc \(BAC\) of its circumcircle. Let \(M, N\) be the midpoints of \(AB, AC\) and \(J, E, F\) the touchpoints of the incircle \((I)\) of \(\triangle ABC\) with \(BC, CA, AB\). The line \(MN\) intersects \(JE, JF\) at \(K, H\) respectively; \(IJ\) intersects the circle \((BIC)\) at \(G\) and \(DG\) intersects \((BIC)\) at \(T\).
a) Prove that \(JA\) passes through the midpoint of \(HK\) and is perpendicular to \(IT\).
b) Let \(R, S\) be the perpendicular projections of \(D\) on \(AB, AC\). Take points \(P, Q\) on \(IF, IE\) respectively such that \(KP\) and \(HQ\) are both perpendicular to \(MN\). Prove that lines \(MP\), \(NQ\) and \(RS\) are concurrent.

Find all functions \(f, g : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\) satisfying \(f(0) = 2022\) and
\[f(x + g(y)) = xf(y) + (2023 - y)f(x) + g(x)\]
for all \(x, y \in \mathbb{R}\).

There are \(n \geq 2\) classes organized into \(m \geq 1\) extracurricular groups. Every class participates in at least one group. Every group has exactly \(a\) classes. For any two groups, at most \(b\) classes participate in both.
a) Find \(m\) when \(n = 8\), \(a = 4\), \(b = 1\).
b) Prove that \(n \geq 20\) when \(m = 6\), \(a = 10\), \(b = 4\).
c) Find the minimum value of \(n\) when \(m = 20\), \(a = 4\), \(b = 1\).

Let \(\triangle ABC\) be scalene with orthocenter \(H\) and circumcenter \(O\). The incircle \((I)\) is tangent to \(BC, CA, AB\) at \(M, N, P\) respectively. Denote \(\Omega_A\) as the circle through \(A\), externally tangent to \((I)\) at \(A'\), cutting \(AB, AC\) again at \(A_b, A_c\). Circles \(\Omega_B, \Omega_C\) and points \(B', B_a, B_c, C', C_a, C_b\) are defined similarly.
a) Prove that \(B_cC_b + C_aA_c + A_bB_a \geq NP + PM + MN\).
b) Suppose \(A', B', C'\) lie on \(AM, BN, CP\) respectively. Let \(K\) be the circumcenter of the triangle formed by lines \(A_bA_c, B_cB_a, C_aC_b\). Prove that \(OH \parallel IK\).
